M01-CAS: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS plane_count FROM airlines LEFT JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM airlines LEFT JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) DESC, airlines.name
M01-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS fleet_size FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M02-CAS: SELECT T2.model, COUNT(T1.aircraft_id) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model
M02-SCH: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id WHERE aircraft.status = 'active' GROUP BY aircraft_types.model ORDER BY aircraft_types.model
M02-BIZ: SELECT T2.model, COUNT(T1.aircraft_id) AS active_count FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model
M02-VAG: SELECT T2.model, COUNT(T1.aircraft_id) AS active_planes FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM airports JOIN flights ON airports.airport_id = flights.origin_airport_id WHERE airports.city = 'Istanbul' AND flights.status = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND airports.icao_code = 'IST'
M03-VAG: SELECT airports.name, COUNT(tracking_events.event_id) AS event_count FROM airports JOIN tracking_events ON airports.airport_id = tracking_events.airport_id WHERE airports.iata_code = 'IST' AND tracking_events.event_code IN ('DEP', 'ARR')
M04-CAS: SELECT T1.name AS from, T2.name AS to, COUNT(*) AS count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = flights.origin_airport_id AND T2.airport_id = flights.destination_airport_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.name, T2.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT origin_airport_id, COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY origin_airport_id ORDER BY COUNT(flight_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo AS T3 ON T2.flight_id = T3.flight_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' AND T3.leg_number = 1 GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) as flight_count FROM flights GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG((strftime('%s', actual_arrival) - strftime('%s', scheduled_arrival)) / 60) AS delay_minutes FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND delay_code IS NOT NULL
M05-SCH: SELECT aircraft.type_id, ROUND(AVG((strftime('%s', flights.actual_arrival) - strftime('%s', flights.scheduled_arrival)) / 60), 1) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.type_id ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, AVG(flights.delay_minutes) FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY airlines.name
M05-VAG: SELECT name FROM airlines ORDER BY founded_year DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name
M06-SCH: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY COUNT(flights.flight_id) DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS cancellation_volume FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name
M06-VAG: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS cancellation_count FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.name
M07-CAS: SELECT airlines.name, SUM(flights.co2_emissions_kg) / 1000 AS total_co2_tonnes FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M07-SCH: SELECT T4.name, AVG(T1.co2_emissions_kg / 1000) AS avg_co2_emissions_kg FROM fuel_uplifts AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.flight_id = T2.flight_id JOIN aircraft AS T3 ON T2.aircraft_id = T3.aircraft_id JOIN airlines AS T4 ON T3.airline_id = T4.airline_id GROUP BY T4.name
M07-BIZ: SELECT aircraft.airline_id, SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) / 1000 AS carbon_footprint_tonnes FROM aircraft JOIN fuel_uplifts ON aircraft.aircraft_id = fuel_uplifts.flight_id GROUP BY aircraft.airline_id
M07-VAG: SELECT airlines.name, SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_emissions_kg FROM airlines JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airlines.airline_id = fuel_uplifts.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name
M08-CAS: SELECT airports.region, AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-SCH: SELECT airports.region, ROUND(AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre), 4) FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-BIZ: SELECT airports.region, AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-VAG: SELECT airports.country, AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_fuel_price FROM airports JOIN fuel_uplifts ON airports.airport_id = fuel_uplifts.airport_id GROUP BY airports.country ORDER BY avg_fuel_price DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.airport_id HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT airports.iata_code, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.iata_code HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.name HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id GROUP BY airports.airport_id, airports.name ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.airport_id HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT airports.iata_code, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.iata_code HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS bonded_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.name HAVING COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, COUNT(warehouses.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports JOIN warehouses ON airports.airport_id = warehouses.airport_id WHERE warehouses.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY airports.airport_id, airports.name
H01-CAS: SELECT a.name, ac.tail_number, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.name, ac.tail_number ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY COUNT(flights.flight_id) DESC, aircraft.tail_number ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT airlines.name, aircraft.model, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS completed_flights FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY airlines.name, aircraft.model
H01-VAG: SELECT a.name, at.model, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN aircraft_types at ON ac.type_id = at.type_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id GROUP BY a.name, at.model ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT T1.name, T2.destination_airport_id, COUNT(T2.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.destination_airport_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.name, T2.destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-SCH: SELECT T1.iata_code, T1.name, COUNT(T2.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T2.destination_airport_id = T1.airport_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.iata_code, T1.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT a.name AS airport_name, ar.name AS airline_name, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM airports a JOIN airlines ar ON a.airport_id = ar.home_hub_airport_id JOIN flights f ON ar.airline_id = f.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND f.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.name, ar.name ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.flight_id) as flight_count FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.origin_airport_id GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT invoices.issued_date, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, SUM(SUM(invoices.amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY invoices.issued_date) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE invoices.issued_date LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY invoices.issued_date ORDER BY invoices.issued_date
H03-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_amount, SUM(SUM(invoices.amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY invoices.issued_date) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE invoices.issued_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY month
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(payments.amount_usd) AS paid_amount FROM invoices LEFT JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id WHERE invoices.issued_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(payments.amount_usd) AS total_payments FROM invoices JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, (COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure))) AS change_from_previous_month FROM flights WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(flights.flight_id) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(flights.flight_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure)) AS previous_month_flights, COUNT(flights.flight_id) - LAG(COUNT(flights.flight_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure)) AS difference FROM flights WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure)
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure) AS month, SUM(flights.distance_km) AS total_volume_km, (SUM(flights.distance_km) - LAG(SUM(flights.distance_km)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure))) / LAG(SUM(flights.distance_km)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure)) AS month_over_month_change FROM flights WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND flights.scheduled_departure LIKE '%/%/2023' GROUP BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.scheduled_departure) AS month, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM flights GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, AVG(flights.scheduled_departure - flights.scheduled_arrival) AS avg_ground_time FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, AVG(julianday(flights.actual_departure) - julianday(flights.actual_arrival)) AS avg_time_diff FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT aircraft.tail_number, AVG(julianday(flights.actual_arrival) - julianday(flights.scheduled_departure)) AS avg_turnaround FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT flight_number, scheduled_departure, scheduled_arrival, actual_departure, actual_arrival, delay_code FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' ORDER BY actual_arrival - actual_departure ASC LIMIT 10
H06-CAS: SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.name, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(invoices.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id HAVING SUM(invoices.amount_usd) > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices)
H06-SCH: SELECT customers.name, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices ) AS percentage FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.shipment_id GROUP BY customers.name HAVING percentage > 0.04
H06-BIZ: SELECT customers.account_code, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS revenue, (SUM(invoices.amount_usd) / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices)) * 100 AS share FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id GROUP BY customers.account_code HAVING SUM(invoices.amount_usd) > (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 0.04 FROM invoices)
H06-VAG: SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.name, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT airports.airport_id, airports.name, SUM(flight_cargo.chargeable_weight_kg) AS total_cargo_tonnes FROM airports JOIN flights ON airports.airport_id = flights.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY airports.airport_id, airports.name ORDER BY total_cargo_tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT airports.name, SUM(flight_cargo.total_weight_kg / 1000) AS tonnes FROM airports JOIN flights ON airports.airport_id = flights.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND flight_cargo.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY airports.name ORDER BY tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT airports.name, SUM(shipments.total_weight_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM airports JOIN shipments ON airports.airport_id = shipments.origin_airport_id GROUP BY airports.name ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT airports.name, COUNT(customs_declarations.declaration_id) AS export_count FROM airports JOIN customs_declarations ON airports.airport_id = customs_declarations.origin_airport_id WHERE customs_declarations.declaration_type = 'export' GROUP BY airports.name ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 1
H08-CAS: SELECT T1.model, COUNT(T2.flight_id) FROM aircraft_types AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo AS T3 ON T2.flight_id = T3.flight_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' AND T3.load_sequence = 1 AND T3.volume_m3 * 0.5 < T3.total_volume_m3
H08-SCH: SELECT T1.model, COUNT(T2.flight_id) FROM aircraft_types AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.aircraft_id JOIN flight_cargo AS T3 ON T2.flight_id = T3.flight_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.model HAVING SUM(T3.total_volume_m3) > 0.5 * T1.max_volume_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft_types JOIN flights ON aircraft_types.type_id = flights.type_id JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND flight_cargo.leg_status = 'flown' AND (flight_cargo.total_volume_m3 / aircraft_types.max_volume_m3) > 0.5 GROUP BY aircraft_types.model
H08-VAG: SELECT aircraft_types.model FROM aircraft_types JOIN flight_cargo ON aircraft_types.type_id = flight_cargo.type_id WHERE flight_cargo.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY aircraft_types.model HAVING AVG(flight_cargo.chargeable_weight_kg / aircraft_types.max_payload_kg) BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.55
H09-CAS: SELECT aircraft.tail_number FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id JOIN airports ON flights.destination_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE airports.is_cargo_hub = 1 AND flights.status = 'completed' AND flights.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT airports.airport_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT aircraft.tail_number FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id JOIN airports ON flights.destination_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE airports.is_cargo_hub = 1 GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT airports.airport_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT aircraft.tail_number FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND airports.region = 'north_america' GROUP BY aircraft.tail_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT airports.region) = 1
H09-VAG: SELECT flights.flight_number, COUNT(DISTINCT flights.origin_airport_id) AS airports_visited FROM flights GROUP BY flights.flight_number ORDER BY airports_visited DESC LIMIT 1
H10-CAS: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) AS tax_count FROM customs_declarations WHERE (duty_rate_pct + vat_rate_pct) * customs_value_usd > 0.2 * customs_value_usd GROUP BY customs_country
H10-SCH: SELECT customs_declarations.customs_country, COUNT(customs_declarations.declaration_id) FROM customs_declarations WHERE customs_declarations.declaration_type = 'import' AND customs_declarations.duty_amount_usd + customs_declarations.vat_amount_usd > 0.2 * customs_declarations.customs_value_usd GROUP BY customs_declarations.customs_country
H10-BIZ: SELECT customs_country AS market, COUNT(*) FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND duty_rate_pct > 20 GROUP BY customs_country
H10-VAG: SELECT customs_country, AVG(duty_rate_pct) AS avg_duty_rate FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' GROUP BY customs_country ORDER BY avg_duty_rate DESC LIMIT 10
